import itertools
import string
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func():
    alphabet = string.ascii_lowercase

    # Generate all 3-letter combinations and store them in a DataFrame
    df = pd.DataFrame(
        itertools.product(alphabet, repeat=3),
        columns=["letter1", "letter2", "letter3"],
    )

    # Plot a histogram of the first-letter frequencies
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    first_letter_codes = df["letter1"].map(ord)
    ax.hist(first_letter_codes, bins=range(ord("a"), ord("z") + 2), edgecolor="black")
    ax.set_xticks(range(ord("a"), ord("z") + 1))
    ax.set_xticklabels(list(alphabet))
    ax.set_xlabel("First letter")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.set_title("Frequency of First Letters in All 3-Letter Combinations")

    return df, ax
